```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(officer)
library(flextable)
```


```{r}

# bootstrapped confidence intervals for model coeficients and predictions are in model_objects



analysis_table <- readRDS(here("data/analysis_table_complete")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(used.available = ifelse(used.available == 0, "available", "used"),
         used.available = factor(used.available),
         sex = ifelse(sex == "F", "Female", "Male")) 



analysis_table_complete <- analysis_table %>% 
  mutate(cohesion = scale(cohesion)[,1],
         impervious = scale(impervious)[,1],
         tre.shr = scale(tre.shr)[,1])

model_predictions <- bind_rows(readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_pred_ci_1000sim_cohesion_patchrd_treshr_impervious_bridgebinary_class_sex_age")) %>% 
                                 mutate(Modnames = "r1_cohesion_patchrd_tre.shr_impervious_bridge.binary_class_sex_age"),
                               readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_pred_ci_1000sim_cohesion2_patchrd_treshr2_impervious2_bridgebinary_class_sex_age")) %>% 
                                 mutate(Modnames = "r2_cohesion2_patchrd_tre.shr2_impervious2_bridge.binary_class_sex_age"))

model_predictions <- model_predictions  %>%
  mutate(which.round = case_when(str_detect(Modnames, "r1_") ~ "a priori",
                                 str_detect(Modnames, "r2_") ~ "round 2")) %>% 
  mutate(Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "r1_|r2_", ""),
         Modnames = str_replace_all(Modnames, "_", " + "),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "cohesion", "Cohesion"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "patchrd", "CrossWoody"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "tre.shr", "% Woody"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "impervious", "% Impervious"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "bridge.binary", "Bridge/culvert"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "class", "Class"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "sex", "Sex"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "age", "Age"),
         Modnames = str_replace_all(Modnames, "2", "²")) %>% 
  mutate(sex = ifelse(sex == "F", "Female", "Male"))
  
available_locs_predicted_crossing_prob <- readRDS(here("model_objects/available_locs_predicted_crossing_prob"))

available_locs_predicted_crossing_prob <- available_locs_predicted_crossing_prob %>% 
  mutate(sex = ifelse(sex == "F", "Female", "Male"))

```




```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=7, eval=FALSE}

# sex and age

mod_plot_sex_age = model_predictions %>%
  filter(patchrd == 0, 
         bridge.binary == 0, 
         class == "Local", 
         cohesion.orig == mean(analysis_table$cohesion), 
         tre.shr.orig == mean(analysis_table$tre.shr),
         impervious.orig == mean(analysis_table$impervious)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(y = prediction, x = sex, color = Modnames), size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, x = sex, color = Modnames), linewidth = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.25) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Relative\nprobability of crossing",
       color = "",
       fill = "",
       title = "Raw used and available") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw()   +
  theme(#legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical",
         legend.position = c(0.05, 0.99),   # inside top-right
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"), # box with border
    legend.title = element_blank()) +
  ylim(0, 0.55)  +
  facet_wrap(~age)


  
raw_plot_sex_age = analysis_table %>% 
  group_by(age, sex, used.available) %>% 
  summarise(group.ua = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(used.available) %>% 
  mutate(total.ua = sum(group.ua),
         ua.proportion = group.ua/total.ua) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = sex, y = ua.proportion, fill = as.factor(used.available)), width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Sex",
       y = "Proportion of\nroad segments",
       fill = "") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw()   +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.8, 0.9),   # inside top-right
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"), # box with border
    legend.title = element_blank() # makes sure no space for title
  )  +
  facet_wrap(~age)

cowplot::plot_grid(mod_plot_sex_age, raw_plot_sex_age, ncol = 1, 
                   rel_heights = c(0.6, 0.4),
                   align = "v",      # align vertically
                   axis = "lr"       # align left & right edges
                   )

```


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=7}

# road class


raw_plot_class = analysis_table %>% 
  group_by(class, sex, used.available) %>% 
  summarise(group.ua = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(sex, used.available) %>% 
  mutate(total.ua = sum(group.ua),
         ua.proportion = group.ua/total.ua) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = class, y = ua.proportion, fill = as.factor(used.available)), width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Proportion of\nroad segments",
       fill = "",
       title = "Raw used and available") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw()   +
  theme(
    #legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9),   # inside top-right
    #legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"), # box with border
    legend.title = element_blank() # makes sure no space for title
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~sex)

mod_plot_class = model_predictions %>%
  filter(age == "adult", 
         patchrd == 0, 
         bridge.binary == 0, 
         cohesion.orig == mean(analysis_table$cohesion), 
         tre.shr.orig == mean(analysis_table$tre.shr),
         impervious.orig == mean(analysis_table$impervious),
         which.round == "round 2") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(y = prediction, x = class, color = sex), size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, x = class, color = sex), linewidth = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.25) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Relative\nprobability of crossing",
       color = "",
       fill = "",
       title = "Modelled preference") +
#  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw()   +
  theme(#legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical",
         #legend.position = c(0.9, 0.99),   # inside top-right
    #legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"), # box with border
    legend.title = element_blank()) #+
  #ylim(0, 0.6)

sex_class_integrated_probs <- available_locs_predicted_crossing_prob %>% 
  group_by(sex, class, used.available) %>% 
  summarise(integrated.prob = sum(predicted.crossing.prob)) %>% 
  ungroup()

sex_class_integrated_probs <- sex_class_integrated_probs %>% 
  mutate(ref.integrated.prob = ifelse(sex == "Female", filter(sex_class_integrated_probs, sex == "Female", class == "Local") %>% pull(integrated.prob), filter(sex_class_integrated_probs, sex == "Male", class == "Local") %>% pull(integrated.prob)),
    integrated.relative.use = integrated.prob/ref.integrated.prob)

integrated_prob_plot <- sex_class_integrated_probs %>% 
 # filter(class != "Local") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = class, y = integrated.relative.use, color = sex, group = sex)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.25)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = 1, ymax = integrated.relative.use), linewidth = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.25)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "Integrated relative\nprobability of crossing",
       x = "Road class",
       title = "Estimated true use") +
  theme_bw()   +
  theme(#legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical",
    #     legend.position = c(0.9, 0.99),   # inside top-right
    #legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"), # box with border
    legend.title = element_blank()) #+
  #ylim(0, 1.6)

cowplot::plot_grid(raw_plot_class, mod_plot_class, integrated_prob_plot, ncol = 1, 
                   rel_heights = c(0.33, 0.33, 0.33),
                   align = "v",      # align vertically
                   axis = "lr"       # align left & right edges
                   )



  
```
